# taking a brewed potion out of its slot awards the brew_potion advancement
MENU A cid=1 type=minecraft:brewing_stand state=18 carried=minecraft:potion*1{minecraft:potion_contents:{potion:"minecraft:awkward"}}
MS 1 minecraft:potion*1{minecraft:potion_contents:{potion:"minecraft:awkward"}}
MS 2 minecraft:potion*1{minecraft:potion_contents:{potion:"minecraft:awkward"}}
MS 3 minecraft:nether_wart*2
MS 4 minecraft:blaze_powder*2
MS 5 minecraft:dirt*4
MS 37 minecraft:glistering_melon_slice*2
MD 0 0
MD 1 19
MD 2 400
MD 3 20
ADV A minecraft:adventure/adventuring_time minecraft:plains
ADV A minecraft:nether/brew_potion potion
ADV A minecraft:recipes/brewing/magma_cream has_blaze_powder
ADV A minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/nether_wart_block has_nether_wart
ADV A minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/red_nether_bricks has_nether_wart
ADV A minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
ADV A minecraft:recipes/misc/ender_eye has_blaze_powder
ADV A minecraft:recipes/misc/fire_charge has_blaze_powder
PKT A minecraft:container_set_slot 140112000000
PKT A minecraft:set_cursor_item 6201f7090100350103000000
